description:
Perform a full database backup of the Copper Point of Sale system.

Your task:
1. Open NCH Copper Point of Sale (if not already open).
2. Locate the backup functionality within the application menus (typically under File or Tools).
3. Initiate a database backup.
4. Save the backup file to the folder 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\POS_Backup\'.
5. Ensure the backup completes successfully.
